name: Brasileodactylus
sum: Anhanguerid from the Romualdo Formation of Brazil; the famous ‘Cearadactylus’ skull was synonymised with it in 2025.
holotype: MN 4804-V — Romualdo Formation, Araripe Basin (front of lower jaw; damaged in the 2018 Museu Nacional fire, casts survive).
material: Six confirmed specimens, mostly lower jaws, plus the skull MN 7019-V (ex-Cearadactylus).
biology: Medium-sized fish-eating anhanguerid with a tooth rosette; a small snout crest and blade-like lower-jaw crest have been reported.
author: Kellner 1984
